title: Phase 1G-H second independent delta audit of the remediation

auditor.name: Claude (Anthropic), Claude Code cloud session
auditor.independence: same model family as the author (a Claude session); not the system of the two earlier audits (OpenAI Codex); no contact with the author or access to its conversation; procedural independence only

checkpoint.blind_to: the author's full-precision artifact values, logs, new evidence-script functions and test expectations
checkpoint.not_blind_to: three-decimal values quoted in the prompt, the revised report and the remediation record (read for model definitions)

out: a new full audit of unchanged 1G-H parts

method: blind reconstruction with own code before reading the author's numbers (Owen's T, Stein moments, exponential tilting, QAWO Hankel transforms, Gauss-Legendre ball quadrature)
reproduction on CPython 3.13.16 and 3.11.17 with every input regenerated
regression against 5c325e1 and comparison with the delta audit's saved evidence
inventory reconciliation, lexical search, SHA-256 checks, read-only remote state

GH-DF1.reason: shared constraints narrowed at every current location; m_II, 1/m_II^2, <C_W - 1> reproduce blind; (H25) exact

GH-DF2.reason: five accepted replacements refused; 27 further probes pass only tolerance-looser, metadata or type substitutions

GH-DF3.reason: section 8 current; dated note supersedes the count; no active retired claim

GH-DF5.reason: requested tests exist and kill their mutants; new gaps are GH-D2F2

GH-DF6.reason: qualifier beside every README/CLAUDE median value

owner_confirmation_gh_f15.verbatim: Confermo le due approvazioni di push registrate (GH-F15)
owner_confirmation_gh_f15.given_to: the auditor of this second delta audit, in the handoff message

findings.title: Today's push (P7) is unrecorded and its superseded statements are incompletely listed
findings.statement: The fast-forward 89cb041 -> 226e52d of 2026-10-08 followed the commits; statements that read as current are superseded and the publication successor's dated-statement table lists only one of them.
findings.consequence: README, CLAUDE and the inventories present the second remediation as unpublished.
locations: CLAUDE.md 1G-H entry ('at 89cb041', 'remediated locally on top of it')
findings.suggested_resolution: Add a dated 2026-10-08 publication entry P7 (89cb041 -> 226e52d carrying 5c325e1, 248a06b, 226e52d; remote head verified; authorisation as quoted by the owner) and the direct GH-F15 confirmation; extend the current-reading table to the listed statements; keep historical text; update the README/CLAUDE current summaries.

findings.title: New reported quantities and the new gates are weakly protected
findings.statement: <C_W - 1> and 1/m_II^2 are untested (mutants A18, A20 survive tests and gates); the radial refinement estimator can be made vacuous (A15); the binding tolerance (A01) and the interval class_assumptions binding (A07) are untested; the (H25) gate compares two sums of the same kernel arrays; in the GH-DF1 test the m^-2 ratio holds by construction and m cancels in the E[chi chi psi psi] check.
findings.evidence: mutation_results.json; implementation code reading; blind reconstruction (values correct)
findings.consequence: Future edits could change printed <C_W - 1> or 1/m_II^2 values or weaken the binding without a failing test or gate. No present numerical error.
findings.suggested_resolution: Add a synthetic-kernel test of both_walls_conditional_density_covariance_ball and of conditional_density_covariance_ratio_II_over_I; a Monte Carlo test of E[psi1 psi2 | both walls] with psi normalised by the sample conditional mean; a _Ball test with a known coarse/fine difference; tampers at 2*RECORD_IDENTITY_RTOL and of class_assumptions; describe the (H25) gate as a consistency check of the (H18) assembly.

findings.title: The regression statement of the second remediation is not literally reproducible
findings.statement: Three gate read-outs outside the pairs changed; counts inside are 160 changed (156 numeric, 140 beyond round-off, 4 text), 6 renamed, 106 added (16 added outside), not 130 / 6 / 108.
findings.consequence: None for physical values; the verification record overstates its precision.

findings.title: Typed records accept any numbers.Real; a Fraction breaks strict JSON
findings.statement: dataclasses.replace(record, linear_sigma=Fraction(record.linear_sigma)) passes every invariant and the binding; to_json_dict then fails json.dumps (TypeError). Pre-existing at 5c325e1; not reported by earlier audits (NEW).
findings.consequence: The strict-JSON contract is not enforced at construction.
findings.suggested_resolution: Coerce validated scalars to float in __post_init__ (as LastScatteringMatching does) or require float.

findings.title: Historical blocks keep the refuted 'same shared constraints' wording without a pointer
findings.statement: The first remediation record (D3 row, l. 61), its inventory (l. 113) and the regenerated 1G-H inventory revision.owner_decisions.D3 still say 'with the same shared constraints'; the dated status note names the counts and GH-DE6 but not GH-DF1; the record's files_changed_sha256 describe 89cb041 without saying so.
findings.consequence: Minor risk of reading a 2026-10-07 statement as current.
findings.suggested_resolution: One sentence in the dated note (pairs share the carrier law, not the conditionally normalised density, GH-DF1; hashes refer to 89cb041); mark the inventory block historical.

findings.title: State the missing input as the mask-carrier dependence
findings.statement: Under mask-carrier independence (E3, law I) f_v0, P11 and the carrier law fix C_W and the hybrid variance; the pairs show that the mask-carrier dependence (kappa0, kappa(r)) is the further input.
findings.consequence: None; the current reading is correct.

errata_of_second_remediation.quoted: every common leaf outside two_phase_covariance/*/gaussian_threshold_pair bitwise identical; inside it, 130 leaves changed (the radial panel and the narrowed constraint texts), 6 renamed, 108 added
errata_of_second_remediation.correct_reading: every common physical leaf outside the pairs is bitwise identical; three gate read-outs of pair quantities change at <= 1.2e-5 absolute; inside, 160 changed (156 numeric, 140 beyond round-off, 4 constraint texts), 6 renamed, 106 added; 16 added outside
